title: Armand Hug and Don Ewell as Morton interpreters
summary: Who might make a good album of Morton's music: Armand Hug and Don Ewell, compared on force and style.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: You know, there's a man that could do a good job on an album of Jell-Roll-Martin things,
don't you think, Hugg?
Armand Huggbid.
Oh, I think he could. He played a wonderful piano the other night. I don't know if I heard that last one.
And he seems to research them so well. Yeah. He knows his tunes.
Oh, he does. Yes, he does. I'd like to know how to interest him.
Oh, I think he'd be very interested. I think if I have his address, I'll write him some of these days.
Well, I think I corresponded with him for a while there in the early days.
Well, would you rather have him try something like that than others that have been trying it?
Well, as far as I know, he'd do as well as anybody I can think of, better than some, I think.
Don Yule would be good.
Don Yule would do well, yes.
Well, I think Yule would, but I think that Hugg really has a tremendous interest in the
magic. I think he probably would have more interest. Although, Don, the time that I talked to him was awful.
I think maybe that Hugg has more force, more force in his fingers, if you want to put it that way.
But he does.
Don has a wonderful general style.

Well, Don told me, you know, when I talked to him down there at the beach with T-Garden, he was with T-Garden, he went over with us that night, he said, I said, I noticed you played some general stuff and featured it. He said, yes, I love that. I said, I made Jack, you know, I wanted to put that in the book. And he would tell me, he said, T-Garden, you know, it's pretty easy to work with that way. He says, anything that's good, he says, oh yeah, we'll do it. And that's all there is to it. So he played several piano solo things, The Crave and some of the others that he did, general stuff. So I think he, but I agree.
Was that lately?
That was some a year ago. See, he was playing with T-Garden's band.
